Everything checks out: typecheck clean, selector lint clean, existing 72 epics unit tests pass.

## Summary

I imported and diffed the `Epics.html` design (claude.ai/design project `0ca33cd3-c2fa-4644-b728-bde42292abbd`) against the current app. The two-pane Epics workspace it describes (queue + detail, search/filter/group/sort/pin/paging/keyboard nav, Chat⇄Terminal toggle, Discussion/PRDs/Runs tabs, the rich Turn renderer) was **already fully implemented** in a prior session (PRDs 827/828/829/831/833/837) — my earlier reading of `EpicComposer.tsx`/`EpicDetail.tsx`/`EpicQueue.tsx` confirmed this before I touched anything.

The remote design had moved on since that sync, adding a per-row overflow menu (rename/edit-goal/pin/mark-completed/duplicate/resume-in-terminal/copy-id/delete) plus a Composer quote-reply affordance and an 8-situation Turn split (`epic-thread.jsx`). I:

1. **Implemented the safe subset now**, in `src/renderer/components/epics/EpicQueue.tsx`: a `RowMenuButton`/`RowMenu` overflow menu offering **Copy Epic ID**, **Mark completed**, and **Resume in terminal** — all backed by existing store actions, no new persistence. Typecheck, `lint:selectors`, and all 72 existing Epics unit tests pass.
2. **Filed proposed Epic** `epic-queue-row-actions-rename-duplicate-delete-63b84dd6` for the remainder (rename/edit-goal/duplicate/delete) — these need new store+IPC mutations that must respect the single-writer law and the already-fragile active-index.json write serialization, so I scoped that as real design work rather than rushing it into this pass.
3. **Refreshed the local design-mock docs** (`design-mocks/epics/epics-mock.jsx`, new `epic-thread-mock.jsx`, `DESIGN_SPEC.md`) so the next sync has an accurate baseline, and explicitly noted that `ChatTranscriptTurn.tsx` already covers the mock's 8 Turn situations against real data (not a gap) — the one genuine small gap is Composer quote-reply, not yet filed as its own Epic.

No — I scoped this deliberately, and not everything is done. Here's the honest breakdown:

**What I implemented (UI + wired to real store/API paths, but no new tests written for it):**
- Row overflow menu (`RowMenuButton`/`RowMenu` in `EpicQueue.tsx`) with 3 actions:
  - **Copy Epic ID** — pure clipboard, no backend.
  - **Mark completed** — calls the *existing* `usePromptSessions().markCompleted` action (same one `EpicDetail`'s button already used).
  - **Resume in terminal** — calls the *existing* `useEpicTerminal().setMode` action.
- These reuse pre-existing, already-tested store/IPC paths. I did **not** write new unit tests for the menu component itself (no test asserts the menu opens, positions, or that each item fires its handler) — I only confirmed the pre-existing 72 Epics tests still pass, which they would regardless of whether the new menu code is correct, since none of them exercise it.

**What I explicitly did NOT implement (real gaps, not oversights):**
1. **Rename title / Edit goal (inline RowEditor)** — no button, no modal, no store mutation. `PromptSession` has no title/goal-patch action today.
2. **Duplicate as new Epic** — not implemented. No mutation exists.
3. **Delete Epic** — not implemented. Destructive, no confirm modal, no precedent in this codebase.
4. **Reopen** (for a completed Epic from the queue row) — not implemented; only `markCompleted` (one direction) is wired.
5. **Composer quote-reply** (TUser's hover "Quote" → reply-context strip in the composer) — not implemented at all, not even filed as its own Epic yet.

Items 1–4 are filed as proposed Epic `epic-queue-row-actions-rename-duplicate-delete-63b84dd6` (requires new store+IPC mutations respecting the single-writer law — I judged that unsafe to rush). Item 5 (quote-reply) is a real gap I flagged in the docs but have not yet filed.

**On "tested":** typecheck, `lint:selectors`, and the existing 72 Epics unit tests pass — but that only proves I didn't break anything pre-existing. No …

Filed all four PRDs into the approved Epic `psess-msaup10i-1` (this conversation's own Epic — confirmed its `claudeSessionId` matches, satisfying `/develop`'s Epic-gate), via `scheduler_create_prd` so numbering/slugs were allocated atomically:

| NN | Slug | Depends on | ETA | What it builds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **909** | `epic-mutation-layer-rename-dup-delete` | — | ~25 min | Backend: `renameEpic`, `duplicateEpic`, `deleteEpic` store actions in `promptSessions.ts`, respecting the single-writer law + existing atomic-write serialization; also amends the CLAUDE.md invariant about title/goal being fixed-for-life to carve out cosmetic rename. |
| **910** | `epic-row-menu-wiring` | 909 | ~22 min | UI: extends `EpicQueue.tsx`'s existing `RowMenuButton`/`RowMenu` with Rename/Edit-goal (inline `RowEditor`), Duplicate, Delete (two-step confirm, toast on error), Reopen. |
| **911** | `epic-composer-quote-reply` | — (independent, can run in parallel with 909/910) | ~18 min | Hover "Quote" on a turn → dismissible reply-context strip in `EpicComposer`. The one real gap flagged earlier that had no PRD yet. |
| **912** | `epic-row-menu-test-coverage` | 909, 910, 911 | ~20 min | Unit tests for all 8 menu actions (including the 3 I landed inline last turn with zero coverage) + quote-reply, **plus a mandatory manual click-through with screenshots** — I called out in the AC that green typecheck/tests alone don't prove a button renders. |

All four carry the mandatory test/security AC inline (per `standards.md`, not spun into separate PRDs) and point the headless executor at `standards.md`'s absolute path. You can watch them in the Scheduler tab, or run them now via "Run now" — **I cannot poll or report back on their progress myself**, since this is a one-shot session that ends when I stop writing.

**On your second ask** — "make sure that this is the starting grounding for EPICs of type Feature and Bug" — I did not queue anything for this because I genuinely can't tell which of t…

## Summary

**Instruction-file grounding (done now, inline — per `developer_sg.md`'s exception for assistant-instruction files, not application code):**
- `plugins/session-manager-dev/skills/develop/SKILL.md` — added a "Tag-aware default" note right after the Epic-gate section: **feature/bug** Epics treat PRD decomposition as the expected next step (`/develop` fires proactively); **discussion** Epics keep `/develop` fully available but never assumed until it's actually decided that building is the right move.
- `CLAUDE.md`'s Epic-tag line — one-sentence pointer to that rule, so the domain model and the skill stay in sync without duplicating the policy text in two places.

**PRD work queued last turn — status check this turn:** confirmed via `queue.json` and the working tree that PRD **909** (backend rename/duplicate/delete mutation layer) is already executing autonomously — `renameEpic`/`duplicateEpic`/`deleteEpic` are live in `promptSessions.ts` and the CLAUDE.md invariant carve-out already landed. **910/911/912** remain queued behind their `dependsOn` chain. I did not touch any of that in-flight code this turn — only the two instruction files above.

Nothing further is blocked; no question needed this turn.

Confirmed — `git push origin main` succeeded (git reported "Everything up-to-date" because the push had already landed by the time the command ran). `HEAD` and `origin/main` now both point to `8eee330`, and the branch-tracking line shows no more ahead/behind gap.

## Summary
- Pushed the 4 completed PRD commits (`244f06f` rename/duplicate/delete mutations, `a3f72af` row-menu wiring, `9bf629a` composer quote-reply, `5908155` test coverage) to `origin/main`.
- Left the unrelated pre-existing uncommitted files (`App.tsx`, `TabBar.tsx`, `ProjectsWorkspace.tsx`, `navGroups.ts`, `layout.ts`, `styles.css`, new navface tests) untouched — they predate this session's work and weren't part of what was asked to push.
- `origin/main` and local `main` are now in sync at `8eee330`.

## Summary

Matched `EpicComposer.tsx`'s prompt panel to your screenshot:

- **Merged the two header rows into one**, matching the screenshot exactly: `[Chat | Dispatch as PRD]` toggle → `in` → status dot + Epic title, all on a single line (was previously a separate "iterating in..." row above the toggle row).
- **Added a folder/attach icon button** next to the mic button inside the joined input-tools box (with a divider), wired to the same `att.add(...)` attachment flow — this was a real gap: `DESIGN_SPEC.md` already documented "mic + attach in a joined button group" but the attach half was never built.
- **Suppressed the full-width dashed drop-zone when empty** (new `hideZoneWhenEmpty` prop on the shared `AttachTray`, opt-in so `NewEpicCard`'s own usage is untouched) — it only appears once there are actual attachment chips to show, matching the clean single-row look in the screenshot instead of always showing "Paste a screenshot... / Attach".
- **Shortened the running placeholder** to `"Queue a follow-up…"` to match the screenshot text exactly.
- **Added a send/paper-plane icon** to the Send/Queue button, matching the screenshot's icon+label button.

Fixed one test that broke as a side effect (it queried the AttachTray's now-conditionally-hidden file input; retargeted it to the new dedicated `epic-composer-attach-input`). `npm run typecheck`, `check-unstable-selectors`, and the full epics test suite (94 tests) all pass. This was small, contained, directly-requested visual work, done inline per `developer_sg.md`'s "user explicitly says to do it inline right now" exception — nothing queued to the scheduler for this pass.

## Summary

Filed 4 PRDs into the same approved Epic (`psess-msaup10i-1`), grounded in what I actually read in the code (not assumptions):

| NN | Slug | Depends on | ETA | What it builds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **913** | `chat-turn-card-contrast` | — | ~15 min | Fixes the near-invisible `bg-elev`/`bg` contrast so turns read as bounded cards instead of a wall of text. |
| **914** | `chat-turn-outcome-wiring` | — | ~20 min | Wires `ChatTurn.outcome` (typed, rendered, but never populated — confirmed via its own "no producer yet" comment) to a real, honestly-derived completion signal. |
| **915** | `chat-turn-diff-data-capture` | — | ~25 min | Backend-only: threads the Edit/Write tool-use `input` payload — already classified by `classifyTranscriptLine.cjs` but dropped before reaching `ChatTurn` — into a new `diff` field on `ToolUseTrace`. |
| **916** | `chat-turn-diff-rendering` | 915 | ~22 min | UI: renders a real collapsible diff card from that data — the actual mock-vs-reality gap closest to what your screenshots show missing. Explicitly scoped OUT the mock's Accept/Reject buttons, since there's no real backing action for them (an Edit is already on disk by render time) — flagged rather than building inert buttons. |

I did not implement any of this inline — per `developer_sg.md`, this is real investigative/feature work (confirmed by reading `chat.ts`, `ChatTranscriptTurn.tsx`, and the main-process transcript classifier), not a one-line fix, so it routes through the scheduler rather than being hand-edited in this session. I can't monitor these PRDs running to completion from this one-shot turn — check the Scheduler tab, or ask again in a future turn to check status.

## Summary

Made 4 commits, not pushed (you didn't ask to push this time):

1. `a170d40` **feat(epics): redesign composer prompt panel to match Epics.html mock** — `EpicComposer.tsx`, `attachments.tsx`, its test.
2. `a82edbf` **docs(epics): tag-aware /develop default + refresh design-mock reference docs** — the `SKILL.md` feature/bug-vs-discussion policy + refreshed `DESIGN_SPEC.md`/`epics-mock.jsx`/`epic-thread-mock.jsx`.
3. `59d0a7e` **fix(chat): wrap long unbroken tokens instead of overflowing the chat column** — this was a small, unrelated `styles.css` fix that had been sitting dirty since *before* this whole conversation started (not something I authored) — committing it now since it's a legitimate, self-contained, non-sensitive change, called out here so you know it's included.
4. `f1628d9` **chore(ops): sync scheduler/Epics state** — active-index, transcripts, archived PRDs 907–916, reserved-number markers — matches this repo's own established convention for this exact kind of commit (verified against prior `chore(ops): sync scheduler/Epics state` commits in the log).

`npm run typecheck` is green post-commit.

**Left untracked, not committed**: `src/renderer/session-manager-operations/scheduler/state/queue.json` — an oddly-nested duplicate `session-manager-operations/` directory that appeared *inside* `src/renderer/`. This looks like an accidental artifact (something resolved its cwd wrong and wrote scheduler state under the renderer source tree instead of the project root), not real source — I left it alone rather than guess whether to delete or keep it.

Cleaned up — the stray directory is gone. The remaining modified files are just this conversation's own live transcript/active-index churn (updates as this session keeps running), not something to commit mid-flight.

## Summary
- Pushed the 5 pending commits — `origin/main` is now at `6327fda`.
- Investigated and removed `src/renderer/session-manager-operations/` — a stray, empty, untracked scheduler-state artifact (`{"jobs": []}`, created today) with no legitimate code path pointing at it; confirmed harmless before deleting.

- stripe:explain-error: Explain Stripe error codes and provide solutions with code examples
- stripe:test-cards: Display Stripe test card numbers for various testing scenarios
- session-manager-dev:blog-for-project-feature: Produce a self-contained, interactive HTML "feature showcase" for one project + one feature — Project Mission & Description, Feature Description (with an optional generated companion illustration), and a Click-Through Demo built from REAL screenshots (never mockups) — one aspect revealed at a time. Output is a single portable HTML file uploadable anywhere (no server, no build step). Distinct from blog-from-git (which drafts narrative bilko.run changelog posts from git history) — this is an evergreen, per-feature product page, not a dated post. Orchestrates 8 nested sub-skills (blog-for-project-feature:select, :research, :storyboard, :capture, :draft-copy, :illustrate, :compose, :review) so each step is independently invokable and inspectable. Use for "make a feature page for X", "showcase this feature", "/blog-for-project-feature", "interactive demo of X", or turning a shipped feature in Session Manager / Social Signal Builder (or any project) into something you can hand someone a link to.
- session-manager-dev:develop: Lead a software-development task by analyzing it from multiple angles (positive path, edge cases, interaction effects, integration, UI validation) and decomposing it into a series of self-contained PRDs — either a handful of independent small PRDs, or a 3-5 PRD evolving chain with sub-tasked acceptance criteria for larger asks — queued for the session-manager scheduler, each pointing the headless executor at the engineering standards file to read at runtime — then track those PRDs to completion, verify them against their acceptance criteria, and report back. Use whenever the user says "/develop", "develop X", "build me X", "implement X", "let's code X", or otherwise starts dev work that should run as scheduled PRDs rather than inline now. This skill is the home for the developer-only guidance (performance, debugging, API-reuse, TDD) that was removed from the always-on global CLAUDE.md. Keywords: develop, build, implement, code, feature, refactor, bugfix, queue dev work, PRDs, PRD chain, multi-angle analysis.
- session-manager-dev:discover-features: Propose and prototype NEW features for the current project. Reads the project's issues, PRs, `main`, and md/docs to learn its objectives, then runs THREE independent discovery sessions (each may also web-search for ideas) that every one proposes 5 high-level feature ideas best fitting the project's goals — 15 total. Synthesises and ranks them, picks the top 3, and runs a high-quality `/develop` build for each. Delivers a deployed URL per feature plus a validation checklist so the human can try them — and NEVER opens a PR or a GitHub issue from a proposed feature (the human validates first, then decides). Use when the user says "/discover-features", "propose features", "discover feature opportunities", "what should we build next", "prototype some new features for me to try". Keywords: discover, propose, feature, opportunity, ideation, prototype, what's next, roadmap.
- session-manager-dev:explain-to-me: Build and maintain session-manager-operations/HUMAN_LEARN/ — a human-readable, visually-rich HTML knowledge base at the repo root that explains how this project actually works. Deep-probes the codebase for a given topic/component (real file:line refs, real constants, real on-disk state — never invented), then writes or updates a clean, self-contained HTML — one combined component page (session-manager-operations/HUMAN_LEARN/index.html) plus a separate skill-chain map (session-manager-operations/HUMAN_LEARN/SKILL_MAP.html) for the local-dev workflow — with advanced CSS, flow diagrams, sticky nav, collapsible tables. Use whenever the user says "/explain-to-me X", "explain X to me", "explain how X works", "document X for me", "add X to HUMAN_LEARN", "make me a human-readable page for X", or "update the skill map". - session-manager-dev:find-opportunity: Triage a shared repo's open issues against open PRs and main to produce a ranked shortlist of what to work on next, PLUS an explicit, reasoned skip-list of what NOT to pick (already claimed by a PR — even one only referenced via the PR's title, not a "Closes #" line — or would conflict with an open PR's diff, or is blocked/needs-decision). - session-manager-dev:pr-review-sweep: Sweep one or more of the current project's PRs' unresolved review comments end-to-end — fetch (paginated), classify by disposition AND bug-vs-feature type, check-if-already-fixed, queue a scheduler PRD per (PR, type), then land-and-resolve once it completes. - session-manager-dev:pr-signal: Request or re-request a reviewer on one PR on the current project's repo — the ONLY step in the PR flow that contacts a person. Deliberately separate from pr-review-sweep and meant to be invoked rarely — most projects don't tag reviewers often. Requires the user's explicit, fresh, per-PR approval every time — a prior approval never carries forward, and CI must be green at the moment of signaling, not just when approval was given. Use only when the user explicitly names a PR number and says to request/ping/notify the reviewer, or approves signaling in response to a pr-review-sweep report.

Epic thread — every conversation situation the Epic chat has to handle,
// and how you answer each one inline. Loads after epics.jsx; exports Turn.

const EP = window.ALMANAC;
const T_DANGER = '#8a2f2f';
const T_ADD = '#4a5730';

function TQuiet({ children, tone }) {
  return <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: tone || EP.inkMute }}>{children}</span>;
}

function TBtn({ children, kind = 'ghost', icon, onClick, disabled }) {
  const fill = kind === 'primary', danger = kind === 'danger';
  return <button onClick={onClick} disabled={disabled} style={{
    appearance: 'none', cursor: disabled ? 'default' : 'pointer', borderRadius: 8, padding: '6px 12px',
    border: fill ? 0 : `1px solid ${danger ? '#dcb6a8' : EP.edge}`,
    background: fill ? EP.accent : EP.card, color: fill ? '#fdf7ee' : danger ? T_DANGER : EP.inkSoft,
    fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: fill ? 650 : 600,
    display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1,
  }}>{icon && <SMIcon name={icon} size={13} />}{children}</button>;
}

// Resolved footer — what the block becomes once you have answered it.
function TDone({ label, note, onUndo }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, marginTop: 11, paddingTop: 10, borderTop: `1px solid ${EP.edge}` }}>
    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 650, color: T_ADD }}>
      <SMIcon name="check" size={13} />{label}
    </span>
    {note && <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>{note}</span>}
    <button onClick={onUndo} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.inkMute }}>Undo</button>
  </div>;
}

// Free-text answer that lives inside the decision block, so a question can be
// answered in your own words without losing the options.
function TReply({ placeholder, onSend, onCancel }) {
  const [v, setV] = React.useState('');
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  React.useEffect(() => { if (ref.current) ref.current.focus(); }, []);
  return <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 7, marginTop: 10 }}>
    <textarea ref={ref} value={v} onChange={e => setV(e.target.value)} rows={2} placeholder={placeholder}
      onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); v.trim() && onSend(v.trim()); } if (e.key === 'Escape') onCancel(); }}
      style={{ width: '100%', resize: 'vertical', appearance: 'none', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.paper, borderRadius: 9, padding: '9px 11px', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5, color: EP.ink, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box' }} />
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, color: EP.inkMute }}>↵ send · esc cancel</span>
      <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
        <TBtn onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</TBtn>
        <TBtn kind="primary" icon="send" onClick={() => v.trim() && onSend(v.trim())} disabled={!v.trim()}>Answer</TBtn>
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

function ToolRow({ tools, running }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const n = tools.reduce((a, t) => a + t[1], 0);
  return <div style={{ marginBottom: 9 }}>
    <button onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} style={{
      appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.panel, borderRadius: 8,
      padding: '4px 10px', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11, color: EP.inkSoft,
    }}>
      <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', transform: open ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'none', transition: 'transform .12s' }}><SMIcon name="chevron" size={11} /></span>
      {running ? 'running' : 'used'} {n} tools
      {running && <span style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: '50%', background: EP.accent }} />}
    </button>
    {open && <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 3, marginTop: 7, paddingLeft: 3 }}>
      {tools.map(([name, c]) => <span key={name} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>
        <span style={{ color: EP.accent, minWidth: 74 }}>{name}</span>
        <span>×{c}</span>
      </span>)}
    </div>}
  </div>;
}

// ── shells ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function TShell({ tone, children, head, at, tools, running }) {
  const alarm = tone === 'ask' || tone === 'perm' || tone === 'error';
  return <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '26px minmax(0,1fr)', gap: 11 }}>
    <span style={{
      width: 26, height: 26, borderRadius: 8, background: alarm ? '#f2d8d0' : EP.card, border: `1px solid ${alarm ? '#dcb6a8' : EP.edge}`,
      display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', fontFamily: EP.serif, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: alarm ? T_DANGER : EP.accent,
    }}>C</span>
    <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 7, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>claude · {at}</span>
        {head}
      </div>
      {tools && <ToolRow tools={tools} running={running} />}
      <div style={{
        background: alarm ? '#fbeee9' : EP.card, border: `1px solid ${alarm ? '#e3c4b8' : EP.edge}`, borderRadius: '4px 12px 12px 12px',
        padding: '12px 15px', fontSize: 13.5, lineHeight: 1.6, color: EP.ink, textWrap: 'pretty',
      }}>{children}</div>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

// ── situations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// 1 · a question with named options, answerable by pick or by prose
function TAsk({ m, state, set }) {
  const [writing, setWriting] = React.useState(false);
  return <TShell tone="ask" at={m.at} tools={m.tools}
    head={<span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: T_DANGER }}>waiting on you</span>}>
    <TQuiet tone={T_DANGER}>Needs your decision</TQuiet>
    <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>{m.text}</div>
    {state ? <TDone label={state.label} note={state.note} onUndo={() => set(null)} /> : writing
      ? <TReply placeholder="Answer in your own words — this becomes the next turn." onCancel={() => setWriting(false)} onSend={t => set({ label: 'Answered', note: `“${t.slice(0, 42)}${t.length > 42 ? '…' : ''}”` })} />
      : <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 6, marginTop: 12 }}>
        {m.options.map((o, i) => <button key={o.label} onClick={() => set({ label: o.label + ' — sent', note: 'resumed' })} style={{
          appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left', border: `1px solid ${i === 0 ? EP.accent : EP.edge}`,
          background: EP.card, borderRadius: 9, padding: '9px 12px', display: 'grid', gap: 2,
        }}>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 650, color: i === 0 ? EP.accent : EP.ink }}>{o.label}</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: EP.inkMute, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>{o.note}</span>
        </button>)}
        <button onClick={() => setWriting(true)} style={{
          appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left', border: `1px dashed ${EP.rule}`, background: 'transparent',
          borderRadius: 9, padding: '8px 12px', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.inkMute,
          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7,
        }}><SMIcon name="pencil" size={12} />Something else — write an answer</button>
      </div>}
  </TShell>;
}

// 2 · a permission gate on a real command
function TPerm({ m, state, set }) {
  return <TShell tone="perm" at={m.at}
    head={<span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: T_DANGER }}>blocked · permission</span>}>
    <TQuiet tone={T_DANGER}>Wants to run</TQuiet>
    <pre style={{ margin: '7px 0 0', padding: '9px 11px', background: '#231d17', color: '#e7d9c2', borderRadius: 8, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.5, overflowX: 'auto' }}>{m.cmd}</pre>
    <div style={{ marginTop: 9, fontSize: 13 }}>{m.text}</div>
    {state ? <TDone label={state.label} note={state.note} onUndo={() => set(null)} />
      : <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 7, marginTop: 12 }}>
        <TBtn kind="primary" icon="play" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Allowed once', note: 'exit 0 · 2.4s' })}>Allow once</TBtn>
        <TBtn icon="shield" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Always allowed', note: `rule added: ${m.rule}` })}>Always allow {m.rule}</TBtn>
        <TBtn kind="danger" icon="x" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Denied', note: 'claude picked another route' })}>Deny</TBtn>
      </div>}
  </TShell>;
}

// 3 · a plan you approve, edit, or send back
function TPlan({ m, state, set }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(false);
  const [steps, setSteps] = React.useState(m.steps);
  return <TShell tone="plain" at={m.at} tools={m.tools}
    head={<span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.accent }}>plan · needs approval</span>}>
    <TQuiet>Proposed plan · {steps.length} steps</TQuiet>
    <ol style={{ margin: '9px 0 0', paddingLeft: 20, display: 'grid', gap: 6 }}>
      {steps.map((s, i) => <li key={i} style={{ fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5, color: EP.ink }}>
        {editing ? <input value={s} onChange={e => setSteps(p => p.map((x, j) => j === i ? e.target.value : x))} style={{
          width: '100%', appearance: 'none', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.paper, borderRadius: 7,
          padding: '5px 8px', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, color: EP.ink, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
        }} /> : s}
      </li>)}
    </ol>
    {state ? <TDone label={state.label} note={state.note} onUndo={() => set(null)} />
      : <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 7, marginTop: 12 }}>
        <TBtn kind="primary" icon="check" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Plan approved', note: `${steps.length} steps queued` })}>Approve & run</TBtn>
        <TBtn icon="pencil" onClick={() => setEditing(e => !e)}>{editing ? 'Done editing' : 'Edit steps'}</TBtn>
        <TBtn icon="file" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Saved as PRD', note: 'contextual-chat.prd.md' })}>Save as PRD</TBtn>
        <TBtn kind="danger" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Sent back', note: 'claude will re-plan' })}>Send back</TBtn>
      </div>}
  </TShell>;
}

function TDiff({ m, state, set }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(true);
  return <TShell tone="plain" at={m.at} tools={m.tools}
    head={<span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>{m.file}</span>}>
    <div>{m.text}</div>
    <div style={{ marginTop: 11, border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, borderRadius: 9, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)} style={{
        appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: 0, width: '100%', textAlign: 'left', background: EP.panel,
        padding: '7px 11px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11.5, color: EP.inkSoft,

        {m.file}
        <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
          <span style={{ color: T_ADD }}>+{m.diff.filter(d => d[0] === '+').length}</span>

          background: sign === '+' ? 'rgba(122,140,80,.13)' : sign === '-' ? 'rgba(138,47,47,.09)' : 'transparent',

        }}>
          <span style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: sign === '+' ? T_ADD : sign === '-' ? T_DANGER : EP.inkMute }}>{sign.trim()}</span>
          <span style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', wordBreak: 'break-word', paddingRight: 10 }}>{line}</span>

        <TBtn kind="primary" icon="check" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Applied', note: `${m.file} written` })}>Accept</TBtn>
        <TBtn icon="reload" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Retrying', note: 'new attempt queued' })}>Retry differently</TBtn>
        <TBtn kind="danger" icon="x" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Rejected', note: 'file left untouched' })}>Reject</TBtn>
      </div>}
  </TShell>;
}

// 5 · a failure, with the output and the ways out
function TError({ m, state, set }) {
  return <TShell tone="error" at={m.at} tools={m.tools}
    head={<span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: T_DANGER }}>failed · exit {m.exit}</span>}>
    <TQuiet tone={T_DANGER}>{m.what}</TQuiet>
    <pre style={{ margin: '7px 0 0', padding: '9px 11px', background: '#231d17', color: '#e0b9b0', borderRadius: 8, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11.5, lineHeight: 1.55, overflowX: 'auto', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>{m.stderr}</pre>
    <div style={{ marginTop: 9, fontSize: 13 }}>{m.text}</div>
    {state ? <TDone label={state.label} note={state.note} onUndo={() => set(null)} />
      : <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 7, marginTop: 12 }}>
        <TBtn kind="primary" icon="reload" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Retried', note: 'passed on attempt 2' })}>Fix and retry</TBtn>
        <TBtn icon="terminal" onClick={() => set({ label: 'Opened in terminal', note: 'session attached' })}>Take it in terminal</TBtn>
        <TBtn onClick={() => set({ label: 'Skipped', note: 'moved to next step' })}>Skip this step</TBtn>
      </div>}
  </TShell>;
}

// 6 · live output you can interrupt without losing the turn
function TStream({ m }) {
  const [stopped, setStopped] = React.useState(false);
  return <TShell tone="plain" at={m.at} tools={m.tools} running={!stopped}
    head={!stopped && <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.accent }}>
      <span style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: '50%', background: EP.accent }} />streaming
    </span>}>
    <div>{m.text}{!stopped && <span style={{ display: 'inline-block', width: 7, height: 14, marginLeft: 3, verticalAlign: -2, background: EP.accent, opacity: 0.75 }} />}</div>
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, marginTop: 11 }}>
      {stopped
        ? <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11, color: EP.inkMute }}>stopped by you — the partial turn is kept</span>
        : <React.Fragment>
          <TBtn kind="danger" icon="stop" onClick={() => setStopped(true)}>Stop</TBtn>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11, color: EP.inkMute }}>or just type below — it queues after this turn</span>
        </React.Fragment>}
    </div>
  </TShell>;
}

// 7 · session-level events that are not anyone's message
function TNote({ m }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '2px 0' }}>
    <span style={{ height: 1, flex: 1, background: EP.rule, opacity: 0.8 }} />
    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
      <SMIcon name={m.icon || 'clock'} size={11} />{m.text}
    </span>
    <span style={{ height: 1, flex: 1, background: EP.rule, opacity: 0.8 }} />
  </div>;
}

// 8 · what the turn actually cost and produced
function TSummary({ m, onOpenPrd }) {
  return <TShell tone="plain" at={m.at} tools={m.tools}
    head={<span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: T_ADD }}>{m.outcome}</span>}>
    <div>{m.text}</div>
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 14, marginTop: 11, paddingTop: 10, borderTop: `1px solid ${EP.edge}` }}>
      {m.stats.map(([k, v]) => <span key={k} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 5, fontSize: 11.5 }}>
        <span style={{ color: EP.inkMute }}>{k}</span>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.inkSoft }}>{v}</span>
      </span>)}
    </div>
    {m.artifact && <button onClick={() => onOpenPrd(m.artifact)} style={{
      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, marginTop: 11, appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
      border: `1px solid ${EP.rule}`, background: EP.paper, borderRadius: 9, padding: '6px 11px',
      fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.inkSoft,
    }}><SMIcon name="file" size={13} />{m.artifact}<SMIcon name="arrowright" size={12} /></button>}
  </TShell>;
}

// ── your side ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function TUser({ m, onQuote }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  return <div onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)} style={{ display: 'grid', justifyItems: 'end', gap: 5 }}>
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
      {hover && <button onClick={() => onQuote(m.text)} style={{
        appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0,
        fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.accent,
      }}>Quote</button>}
      <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>you · {m.at}</span>
      {m.spawned && <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.accent }}>
        <SMIcon name="plus" size={11} /> split into “{m.spawned}”
      </span>}
    </div>
    {m.quote && <div style={{
      maxWidth: 'min(68%, 760px)', borderLeft: `2px solid ${EP.rule}`, padding: '2px 0 2px 10px',
      fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.5, color: EP.inkMute, fontStyle: 'italic',
    }}>{m.quote}</div>}
    <div style={{
      maxWidth: 'min(68%, 760px)', background: '#f2e2ce', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, borderRadius: '12px 12px 4px 12px',
      padding: '11px 14px', fontSize: 13.5, lineHeight: 1.55, color: EP.ink, textWrap: 'pretty',
    }}>
      {m.text}
      {m.files && <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6, marginTop: 9 }}>
        {m.files.map(f => <span key={f} style={{
          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, background: EP.card, border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`,
          borderRadius: 7, padding: '3px 8px', fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11, color: EP.inkSoft,
        }}><SMIcon name={/\.(png|jpg)$/.test(f) ? 'camera' : 'file'} size={11} />{f}</span>)}
      </div>}
    </div>
  </div>;
}

// ── router ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Turn({ m, onOpenPrd, onQuote, state, setState }) {
  const set = (v) => setState(v);
  if (m.role === 'user') return <TUser m={m} onQuote={onQuote || (() => {})} />;
  switch (m.type) {
    case 'ask': return <TAsk m={m} state={state} set={set} />;
    case 'perm': return <TPerm m={m} state={state} set={set} />;
    case 'plan': return <TPlan m={m} state={state} set={set} />;
    case 'diff': return <TDiff m={m} state={state} set={set} />;
    case 'error': return <TError m={m} state={state} set={set} />;
    case 'stream': return <TStream m={m} />;
    case 'note': return <TNote m={m} />;
    case 'summary': return <TSummary m={m} onOpenPrd={onOpenPrd} />;
    default:
      if (m.question) return <TAsk m={{ ...m, options: m.options || [{ label: 'Yes', note: 'proceed' }, { label: 'No', note: 'hold' }] }} state={state} set={set} />;
      return <TShell tone="plain" at={m.at} tools={m.tools} running={m.running}
        head={<React.Fragment>
          {m.running && <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.accent }}>
            <span style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: '50%', background: EP.accent }} />running
          </span>}
          {m.outcome && <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.sage }}>{m.outcome}</span>}
        </React.Fragment>}>
        {m.text}
        {m.artifact && <button onClick={() => onOpenPrd(m.artifact)} style={{
          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, marginTop: 11, appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
          border: `1px solid ${EP.rule}`, background: EP.paper, borderRadius: 9, padding: '6px 11px',
          fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.inkSoft,
        }}><SMIcon name="file" size={13} />{m.artifact}<SMIcon name="arrowright" size={12} /></button>}
      </TShell>;
  }
}

function useAttachments() {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState([]);
  const add = (list) => {
    const next = [...list].map(fl => ({
      id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2), name: fl.name || 'pasted-image.png',
      size: fl.size ? (fl.size > 1e6 ? (fl.size / 1e6).toFixed(1) + ' MB' : Math.max(1, Math.round(fl.size / 1024)) + ' KB') : '—',
      url: fl.type && fl.type.startsWith('image/') ? URL.createObjectURL(fl) : null,
    }));
    if (next.length) setItems(p => [...p, ...next]);
  };
  const remove = (id) => setItems(p => p.filter(i => i.id !== id));
  return { items, add, remove, clear: () => setItems([]) };
}

function RowMenu({ anchor, items, onClose }) {
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  const [pos, setPos] = React.useState(null);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const place = () => {
      const a = anchor.current, m = ref.current;
      if (!a || !m) return;
      const r = a.getBoundingClientRect();
      const h = m.offsetHeight, w = m.offsetWidth, pad = 8;
      const below = window.innerHeight - r.bottom - pad;
      const up = below < h && r.top - pad > below;
      setPos({
        left: Math.max(pad, Math.min(r.right - w, window.innerWidth - w - pad)),
        top: up ? Math.max(pad, r.top - 2 - Math.min(h, r.top - pad * 2)) : r.bottom + 2,
        maxHeight: Math.max(140, (up ? r.top : window.innerHeight - r.bottom) - pad * 2),
      });
    };
    place();
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', place, true);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('resize', place); window.removeEventListener('scroll', place, true); };
  }, [anchor]);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const away = ev => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(ev.target) && !(anchor.current && anchor.current.contains(ev.target))) onClose(); };
    const esc = ev => { if (ev.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', away); document.addEventListener('keydown', esc);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', away); document.removeEventListener('keydown', esc); };
  }, [onClose, anchor]);
  return <div ref={ref} style={{
    position: 'fixed', zIndex: 60, minWidth: 194, overflowY: 'auto',
    left: pos ? pos.left : -9999, top: pos ? pos.top : -9999, maxHeight: pos ? pos.maxHeight : 400,
    visibility: pos ? 'visible' : 'hidden',

      <button key={i} onClick={ev => { ev.stopPropagation(); onClose(); it.run(); }} style={{
        appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: 0, background: 'transparent', textAlign: 'left',
        borderRadius: 7, padding: '6px 9px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,

  React.useEffect(() => { if (first.current) { first.current.focus(); first.current.select && first.current.select(); } }, []);
  const dirty = title.trim() !== e.title || goal.trim() !== e.goal;
  const commit = () => { if (title.trim()) onSave({ title: title.trim(), goal: goal.trim() }); };
  const box = { width: '100%', appearance: 'none', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.paper, borderRadius: 8, padding: '7px 9px', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, color: EP.ink, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box' };
  return <div onClick={ev => ev.stopPropagation()} style={{
    border: `1px solid ${EP.accent}`, background: EP.card, borderRadius: 11, padding: 10, display: 'grid', gap: 7,
    boxShadow: '0 2px 10px rgba(42,34,26,.10)',
  }}>
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 4 }}>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.9, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: EP.inkMute }}>title</span>
      <input ref={field === 'title' ? first : null} value={title} onChange={ev => setTitle(ev.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={ev => { if (ev.key === 'Enter') { ev.preventDefault(); commit(); } if (ev.key === 'Escape') onCancel(); }}
        style={{ ...box, fontWeight: 650 }} />
    </div>
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 4 }}>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.9, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: EP.inkMute }}>goal · first prompt</span>
      <textarea ref={field === 'goal' ? first : null} value={goal} onChange={ev => setGoal(ev.target.value)} rows={4}
        onKeyDown={ev => { if (ev.key === 'Escape') onCancel(); if (ev.key === 'Enter' && (ev.metaKey || ev.ctrlKey)) commit(); }}
        style={{ ...box, resize: 'vertical', lineHeight: 1.5, minHeight: 74 }} />
    </div>
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, color: EP.inkMute }}>⌘↵ save · esc cancel</span>
      <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
        <button onClick={onCancel} style={{ appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.paper, color: EP.inkSoft, borderRadius: 8, padding: '5px 11px', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 }}>Cancel</button>
        <button onClick={commit} disabled={!dirty || !title.trim()} style={{
          appearance: 'none', cursor: dirty && title.trim() ? 'pointer' : 'default', border: 0, borderRadius: 8, padding: '5px 13px',
          background: dirty && title.trim() ? EP.accent : '#e6d5be', color: dirty && title.trim() ? '#fdf7ee' : EP.inkMute,
          fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 650,
        }}>Save</button>
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

  const items = [
    { icon: 'pencil', label: 'Rename title', run: () => setEdit('title') },
    { icon: 'file', label: 'Edit goal / first prompt', run: () => setEdit('goal') },

    { icon: 'pin', label: pinned ? 'Unpin from top' : 'Pin to top', run: () => onPin(e.id) },
    { icon: 'check', label: done ? 'Reopen Epic' : 'Mark completed', run: () => onPatch(e.id, { status: done ? 'active' : 'completed' }) },
    { icon: 'copy', label: 'Duplicate as new Epic', run: () => onDup(e.id) },
    { sep: true },
    { icon: 'terminal', label: 'Resume in terminal', run: () => {} },

    appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: menu ? EP.panel : 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 6,

  }}><SMIcon name="pin" size={13} /></button>;

  if (compact) return <div style={{ position: 'relative' }} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}>
    <button onClick={() => onSelect(e.id)} onDoubleClick={ev => { ev.stopPropagation(); setEdit('title'); }} data-row={e.id} style={{
      appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', display: 'grid',
      gridTemplateColumns: '8px minmax(0,1fr) auto', gap: 7, alignItems: 'center',

      </span>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, color: EP.inkMute, flexShrink: 0, minWidth: 46, textAlign: 'right', opacity: hover || on || pinned ? 0 : 1 }}>{e.activity}</span>

      boxShadow: on ? `inset 3px 0 0 ${st.dot}, 0 1px 2px rgba(42,34,26,.07)` : 'none',
    }}>
      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
        <EChip s={e.status} small />
        <EKind k={e.kind} small />
        <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute, paddingRight: 2, opacity: hover || on || menu || pinned ? 0 : 1 }}>{e.activity}</span>
      </span>

      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>

        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}><SMIcon name="sysprompt" size={11} />{e.turns}</span>

function EpicQueue({ epics, selId, onSelect, onNew, onPatch, onDup, onDelete }) {
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  const [filter, setFilter] = React.useState('open');
  const [group, setGroup] = React.useState('status');
  const [sort, setSort] = React.useState('recent');
  const [compact, setCompact] = React.useState(false);
  const [closed, setClosed] = React.useState(() => new Set(['completed']));
  const [limits, setLimits] = React.useState({});
  const [pins, setPins] = React.useState(() => new Set());

  const counts = epics.reduce((o, e) => (o[e.status] = (o[e.status] || 0) + 1, o), {});
  const openN = epics.length - (counts.completed || 0);
  const matches = React.useMemo(() => {
    const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    return epics.filter(e =>
      (filter === 'all' || (filter === 'open' ? e.status !== 'completed' : filter === 'pinned' ? pins.has(e.id) : e.status === filter)) &&
      (!needle || (e.title + ' ' + e.goal + ' ' + e.kind).toLowerCase().includes(needle)));
  }, [epics, q, filter, pins]);
  const sorted = React.useMemo(() => [...matches].sort(E_SORTS[sort][1]), [matches, sort]);
  const pinned = sorted.filter(e => pins.has(e.id));

  const g = E_GROUPS[group];
  const sections = React.useMemo(() => {
    const buckets = new Map();
    sorted.filter(e => !pins.has(e.id)).forEach(e => {
      const k = g.of(e);
      if (!buckets.has(k)) buckets.set(k, []);
      buckets.get(k).push(e);
    });
    return g.order.filter(k => buckets.has(k)).map(k => ({ key: k, items: buckets.get(k) }));
  }, [sorted, group, pins]);

  const flat = [...pinned, ...sections.filter(s => !closed.has(s.key)).flatMap(s => s.items.slice(0, limits[s.key] || PAGE))];
  const togglePin = (id) => setPins(p => { const n = new Set(p); n.has(id) ? n.delete(id) : n.add(id); return n; });
  const move = (d) => {
    const i = flat.findIndex(e => e.id === selId);
    const next = flat[Math.min(flat.length - 1, Math.max(0, (i < 0 ? 0 : i + d)))];
    if (next) { onSelect(next.id); const el = document.querySelector(`[data-row="${next.id}"]`); if (el && el.offsetParent) el.offsetParent.scrollTop += 0; }
  };
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const h = (ev) => {
      if (ev.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || ev.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || ev.target.tagName === 'SELECT') return;
      if (ev.key === 'j' || ev.key === 'ArrowDown') { ev.preventDefault(); move(1); }
      if (ev.key === 'k' || ev.key === 'ArrowUp') { ev.preventDefault(); move(-1); }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', h);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', h);
  });

  const chips = [
    { k: 'open', l: `Open ${openN}` },
    { k: 'needs', l: `Needs you ${counts.needs || 0}` },
    { k: 'running', l: `Running ${counts.running || 0}` },
    { k: 'pinned', l: `Pinned ${pins.size}` },
    { k: 'all', l: `All ${epics.length}` },
  ];

  return <aside style={{ width: 352, flexShrink: 0, borderRight: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.panel, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', minHeight: 0 }}>
    <div style={{ padding: '13px 14px 11px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${EP.edge}` }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 11 }}>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 1.1, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: EP.inkMute }}>Epic queue</span>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>{epics.length}</span>
        <button onClick={onNew} style={{
          marginLeft: 'auto', appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: 0, borderRadius: 9, padding: '6px 12px',
          background: EP.accent, color: '#fdf7ee', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 650,
          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(42,34,26,.14)',
        }}><SMIcon name="plus" size={14} /> New Epic</button>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <span style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 9, top: 8, color: EP.inkMute, pointerEvents: 'none' }}><SMIcon name="search" size={14} /></span>
        <input value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder={`Search ${epics.length} Epics`}
          style={{ width: '100%', appearance: 'none', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.card, borderRadius: 9, padding: '7px 10px 7px 30px', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, color: EP.ink, outline: 'none' }} />
        {q && <button onClick={() => setQ('')} style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 7, top: 7, appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', color: EP.inkMute, display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name="x" size={13} /></button>}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, marginTop: 9, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {chips.map(t => {
          const on = filter === t.k;
          return <button key={t.k} onClick={() => setFilter(t.k)} style={{
            appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: 0, borderRadius: 7, padding: '3.5px 8px',
            background: on ? EP.card : 'transparent', boxShadow: on ? `inset 0 0 0 1px ${EP.edge}` : 'none',
            fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: on ? 650 : 500, color: on ? EP.ink : EP.inkMute,
          }}>{t.l}</button>;
        })}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginTop: 9, alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <MiniSelect label="group" value={group} onChange={setGroup} options={Object.entries(E_GROUPS).map(([k, v]) => ({ k, l: v.label }))} />
        <MiniSelect label="sort" value={sort} onChange={setSort} options={Object.entries(E_SORTS).map(([k, v]) => ({ k, l: v[0] }))} />
        <button onClick={() => setCompact(!compact)} title={compact ? 'Comfortable rows' : 'Compact rows'} style={{
          marginLeft: 'auto', appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: compact ? EP.card : 'transparent',
          borderRadius: 8, width: 28, height: 26, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', color: compact ? EP.accent : EP.inkMute,
        }}><SMIcon name="tasks" size={13} /></button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', minHeight: 0, padding: '6px 8px 10px' }}>
      {pinned.length > 0 && <>
        <div style={{ position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 2, background: EP.panel, padding: '7px 6px 5px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
          <span style={{ color: EP.accent, display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name="skills" size={11} /></span>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.9, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: EP.inkSoft }}>pinned</span>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, color: EP.inkMute }}>{pinned.length}</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: compact ? 1 : 5, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          {pinned.map(e => <QueueRow key={e.id} e={e} on={e.id === selId} compact={compact} pinned onSelect={onSelect} onPin={togglePin} onPatch={onPatch} onDup={onDup} onDelete={onDelete} />)}
        </div>
      </>}

      {sections.map(s => {
        const shut = !q.trim() && closed.has(s.key);
        const lim = limits[s.key] || PAGE;
        const rest = s.items.length - lim;
        return <div key={s.key} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
          <button onClick={() => setClosed(p => { const n = new Set(p); n.has(s.key) ? n.delete(s.key) : n.add(s.key); return n; })} style={{
            position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 2, width: '100%', appearance: 'none', border: 0, cursor: 'pointer',
            background: EP.panel, padding: '7px 6px 6px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, textAlign: 'left',
          }}>
            <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', color: EP.inkMute, transform: shut ? 'none' : 'rotate(90deg)', transition: 'transform .12s' }}><SMIcon name="chevron" size={11} /></span>
            <span style={{ width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: '50%', background: g.dot(s.key) }} />
            <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.9, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: EP.inkSoft }}>{g.name(s.key)}</span>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, color: EP.inkMute }}>{s.items.length}</span>
            <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', height: 1, flex: 1, background: EP.rule, opacity: 0.7 }} />
          </button>
          {!shut && <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: compact ? 1 : 5 }}>
            {s.items.slice(0, lim).map(e => <QueueRow key={e.id} e={e} on={e.id === selId} compact={compact} pinned={false} onSelect={onSelect} onPin={togglePin} onPatch={onPatch} onDup={onDup} onDelete={onDelete} />)}
            {rest > 0 && <button onClick={() => setLimits(p => ({ ...p, [s.key]: lim + 40 }))} style={{
              appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: `1px dashed ${EP.rule}`, background: 'transparent', borderRadius: 9,
              padding: '7px 10px', margin: '3px 0 2px', fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600, color: EP.inkMute,
            }}>Show {Math.min(40, rest)} more · {rest} hidden</button>}
          </div>}
        </div>;
      })}
      {!sorted.length && <div style={{ padding: '26px 14px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 12.5, color: EP.inkMute, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
        No Epics match “{q}”.<br /><button onClick={() => { setQ(''); setFilter('all'); }} style={{ appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', color: EP.accent, fontFamily: EP.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600, padding: '6px 0 0' }}>Clear filters</button>
      </div>}
    </div>

    <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, padding: '7px 12px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, background: EP.panel }}>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkMute }}>{sorted.length} shown · {counts.needs || 0} need you</span>
      <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10, color: EP.inkMute }}>j / k to move</span>
    </div>
  </aside>;
}

// ── thread turns ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ToolStrip({ tools, running }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const n = tools.reduce((a, t) => a + t[1], 0);
  return <div style={{ marginBottom: 9 }}>
    <button onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} style={{
      appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', border: `1px solid ${EP.edge}`, background: EP.paper, borderRadius: 8,
      padding: '4px 9px', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 11, color: EP.inkSoft,
    }}>
      <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', transform: open ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'none', transition: 'transform .12s' }}><SMIcon name="chevron" size={11} /></span>
      <span>{(running ? 'working · ' : 'used ') + n + (n === 1 ? ' tool' : ' tools')}</span>
      {running && <span style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: '50%', background: EP.accent }} />}
    </button>
    {open && <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 5, marginTop: 7 }}>
      {tools.map(([t, c]) => <span key={t} style={{
        fontFamily: EP.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: EP.inkSoft, background: EP.paper,
        border: `1px solid ${EP.rule}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '2.5px 7px',
      }}>{t}{c > 1 ? ` ×${c}` : ''}</span>)}
    </div>}
  </div>;
}

// ── composer, scoped to the Epic ─────────────────────────────────────
function Composer({ epic, quote, onClearQuote }) {
  const [text, setText] = React.useState('');
  React.useEffect(() => { if (quote && ta.current) ta.current.focus(); }, [quote]);
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState('Chat');
  const running = epic.status === 'running';
  const att = useAttachments();
  const file = React.useRef(null);
  const ta = React.useRef(null);
  const [over, setOver] = React.useState(false);
  const grow = () => {
    const el = ta.current; if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    const chrome = el.offsetHeight - el.clientHeight; // borders, since box-sizing is border-box
    el.style.height = Math.min(150, Math.max(44, el.scrollHeight + chrome)) + 'px';
  };
  React.useEffect(() => { setText(''); att.clear(); }, [epic.id]);

const E_ALL = E_EPICS.concat(window.E_GENERATED || []);

function EpicsPage() {
  const [epics, setEpics] = React.useState(E_ALL);
  const [selId, setSelId] = React.useState(E_ALL[0].id);
  const [creating, setCreating] = React.useState(false);
  const patch = (id, fields) => setEpics(list => list.map(e => e.id === id ? { ...e, ...fields } : e));
  const dup = (id) => setEpics(list => {
    const src = list.find(e => e.id === id); if (!src) return list;
    const copy = { ...src, id: src.id + '-copy-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4), title: src.title + ' (copy)', status: 'draft', sortAge: 0, activity: 'just now', turns: 0, tools: 0, tokens: '0', prds: [], thread: src.thread.slice(0, 1) };
    setSelId(copy.id);
    return [copy, ...list];
  });
  const drop = (id) => setEpics(list => {
    const i = list.findIndex(e => e.id === id);
    const next = list.filter(e => e.id !== id);
    if (id === selId && next.length) setSelId((next[Math.min(i, next.length - 1)]).id);
    return next;
  });
  const epic = epics.find(e => e.id === selId) || epics[0];
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', height: '100%', minHeight: 0, fontFamily: EP.sans, color: EP.ink, background: EP.paper }}>
    <EpicQueue epics={epics} selId={creating ? null : selId} onSelect={(id) => { setSelId(id); setCreating(false); }} onNew={() => setCreating(true)} onPatch={patch} onDup={dup} onDelete={drop} />
    {creating ? <NewEpic onCancel={() => setCreating(false)} /> : <EpicDetail epic={epic} />}
  </div>;
}

// Tiny pixel-art mascot reminiscent of the Claude Code one in the terminal
function SMMascot({ size = 28, fg = '#c96442' }) {
  // 8x8 grid: 1 = filled. A blocky friendly face.
  const grid = [
    '00111100',
    '01111110',
    '11011011',
    '11111111',
    '11011011',
    '01111110',
    '00111100',
    '00100100',
  ];
  const px = size / 8;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 8 8" shapeRendering="crispEdges">
      {grid.map((row, y) => row.split('').map((c, x) =>
        c === '1' ? <rect key={`${x},${y}`} x={x} y={y} width="1" height="1" fill={fg} /> : null
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

type ComposerAction = 'chat' | 'dispatch'

/**
 * Parses the Terminal session's own JSONL transcript, filters to turns not
 * already captured by the durable per-Epic store, and appends each through
 * promptSessionTranscript. Best-effort end to end — a missing/unreadable
 * transcript or an IPC failure resolves to 0 captured rather than throwing,
 * so returnToChat's placeholder fallback always has a safe count to render.
 * Returns the number of newly captured turns.
 */
async function captureTerminalHandoffTurns(cwd: string, epicId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const [transcriptPath, { turns: existingTurns }] = await Promise.all([
      window.api.transcripts.pathFor(cwd, sessionId),
      window.api.promptSessionTranscript.read(cwd, epicId),
    ])
    const lastCapturedAt = existingTurns.length > 0 ? existingTurns[existingTurns.length - 1].at : null
    const result = await window.api.config.readText(transcriptPath)
    if (!result.exists || !result.text) return 0
    const parsed = parseTranscriptTurns(result.text)
    const fresh = selectNewTurns(parsed, lastCapturedAt)
    for (const turn of fresh) {
      await window.api.promptSessionTranscript.append(cwd, epicId, {
        role: turn.role,
        text: turn.text,
        at: turn.at,
      })
    }
    return fresh.length
  } catch {
    return 0
  }
}
